observations: Cline/Qwen performed extensive official-source investigation but the first turn ended before a response or workspace file was delivered.

Cline reported an upstream Alibaba error saying output data may contain inappropriate content. OpenRouter's HTTP-level log nevertheless records 28 successful responses, showing the provider error arrived inside an HTTP 200 stream rather than as a logged request failure.

No webpage exists to open or visually grade. The failed turn took 413.643 seconds; the process ended after 424.235 seconds, USD 0.40530305, 747,855 prompt and 13,995 completion tokens including 7,872 reasoning tokens.
